SELECT 
    c.title AS course_title,
    c.price AS list_price,
    COUNT(e.id) AS total_enrolled,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(e.id) >= 2 THEN '🔥 BEST SELLER'
        WHEN COUNT(e.id) = 1 THEN '📈 POPULAR'
        ELSE '🆕 NEW COHORT'
    END AS tier_status,
    ROUND(c.price * 0.85, 2) AS discounted_fee
FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON c.id = e.course_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.title, c.price
ORDER BY total_enrolled DESC, list_price DESC;
